name_en: Onomi no Sashimi — thin-sliced, marbled whale tail meat eaten raw
summary_ja: 尾びれの付け根からわずかしか取れない霜降りの鯨肉を薄く切り、刺身でいただく太地町の一皿。江戸期から続く古式捕鯨の歴史を持つ町で、骨や皮まで無駄なく食べ尽くす文化の中でも特に希少とされる部位という。
summary_en: Thinly sliced, marbled whale meat from the narrow cut near the tail fin, served raw as sashimi in the town of Taiji. In a town with a history of traditional whaling reaching back to the Edo period, where every part of the whale is used, this cut is counted among the rarest.
source_title: 尾の身の刺身 和歌山県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
